title: Typography / Typesetting Duolingo
slide_intent: Treat the brand name consistently within sentences because small spelling and spacing changes affect the signature people learn.
strategic_value: Typeface-specific casing and a built-in wordmark glyph can keep Duolingo’s name consistent in running messages.
demonstration: Two examples contrast the brand name in Feather Bold and DIN Next Rounded, beside casing and replacement-glyph guidance.
practical_value: Choose the appropriate name treatment for the typeface in use.

content_islands.name: Name specimens
content_islands.spec: Place the large Feather Bold phrase above the smaller DIN sentence in the left panel.

content_islands.name: Typeface-specific rules
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and lowercase, tilde-replacement and sentence-case instructions in the right column.

reference_purposes.Application: The text explains that a tilde in Feather Bold triggers the full logotype with different kerning.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Duolingo is lowercase in Feather Bold and sentence case in DIN Next Rounded.

ingredient.name: Brand-name setting
ingredient.role: Keep the name’s appearance consistent inside copy.
ingredient.application: Set duolingo lowercase in Feather Bold and use its tilde-triggered logotype when possible; set Duolingo in sentence case in DIN.
ingredient.scope: Historical archived guidelines. Historical font-specific behavior; the tilde replacement is not a general rule for other typefaces.
